cases.explain: «неверные весы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.

cases.explain: «Добрая женщина» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.

cases.explain: «золотое кольцо» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

cases.explain: «Щедрая душа» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
